shared_elements: rows of repeated small signs or figures in horizontal registers
justification: Both surfaces carry figural imagery cut into natural rock with small schematic human forms arranged in horizontal rows, but that is about as generic as such a correspondence gets. A shows a formal framed relief panel with an arched top, a symmetrical group of standing figures beneath a winged/radiant emblem, and dense blocks of script-like lines, whereas B shows scattered boats with crew-strokes, footprint shapes and isolated stick figures spread freely over an open rock face with no frame, no symmetry and no text.
